title.zh-CN: gRPC #38002：报告者 CPU 轨迹复核

source_scope.en: The original 60-second C++ and Java recordings were analyzed offline. No local server workload was run.
source_scope.zh-CN: 离线分析原报告的 C++／Java 两份 60 秒 CPU 记录；未在本地运行原服务器负载。

known.en: The reporter observes higher C++ server CPU use at a stated 60 TPS. The attachment contains binary perf data, text stacks and flame graphs for both implementations.
known.zh-CN: 报告者在其所述 60 TPS 负载下观察到 C++ 服务器 CPU 更高；附件含两种实现的 perf 二进制数据、文本栈和火焰图。

claim.en: Build configuration contributes to the difference.
claim.zh-CN: 构建配置影响比较结果。

distinguish.en: Obtain compiler flags and matched shared libraries; compare optimized and original C++ builds with the same application workload. A debug directory name alone is insufficient.
distinguish.zh-CN: 取得编译选项及匹配共享库；用同一应用负载比较原构建与优化构建。debug 目录名本身不能证明未优化。

claim.zh-CN: 应用工作量及预热状态不同。

distinguish.en: Match payloads, completed RPC counts and handler behavior; collect both profiles after a documented warmup.
distinguish.zh-CN: 对齐 payload、实际完成 RPC 数和 handler 行为，并在记录预热过程后重新采集。

claim.en: Runtime or completion-queue overhead remains after matching the controls.
claim.zh-CN: 在对齐条件后仍有 runtime／CompletionQueue 开销。

distinguish.en: Measure per-request CPU with queue/tag identities and isolate processing, completion and waiting without adding overlapping inclusive groups.
distinguish.zh-CN: 按 queue／tag 身份测量逐请求 CPU，区分处理、完成及等待，不累加重叠的 inclusive 分组。

ordinary.en: The original stacks identify execution paths, including CallData::processRequest and response Finish. Many stacks are incomplete or unresolved.
ordinary.zh-CN: 原栈可辨识 CallData::processRequest、响应 Finish 等执行路径，但许多栈有缺帧或未解析符号。

with_coroperf.en: A new capture would need request/tag generations and callback creation/execution records. They are absent from this attachment and cannot be filled in retrospectively.
with_coroperf.zh-CN: 新采集需要请求／tag 代次及回调创建、执行记录；旧附件没有这些数据，无法事后补写。

required_relations.en: The shown C++ code uses thread-driven CompletionQueue callbacks; coroutine use is not established.
required_relations.zh-CN: 已展示的 C++ 代码使用线程驱动的 CompletionQueue 回调，尚未证实使用协程。

required_relations.en: A future attribution needs call/tag lifetime, queue, executing thread and callback generation, not just matching addresses.
required_relations.zh-CN: 进一步归属需要 call／tag 寿命、queue、执行线程及回调代次，不能只匹配地址。

comparisons.en: Recover exact build flags, ELFs, Java JIT maps, server sources and the submitted load configuration.
comparisons.zh-CN: 补齐精确编译选项、ELF、Java JIT map、服务器源码和原负载配置。

comparisons.en: Compare the same implementation with a cause-specific change under matched warmup and observed completed RPC counts.
comparisons.zh-CN: 保持预热和实际完成 RPC 数可比，在同一实现上验证针对原因的改动。

proposed_addition.en: No coroutine or request ancestry is claimed for this offline profile review.
proposed_addition.zh-CN: 本次离线复核不声称已恢复协程或请求祖先。

next_action.en: Verify the actual C++ optimization flags and reproduce the original application comparison before choosing a repair.
next_action.zh-CN: 先核实 C++ 实际优化选项、复现原应用比较，再选择修复。

limits.en: No local incident run or validated repair. Missing ELFs, JIT maps, completed RPC counts and callback identities prevent a root-cause conclusion or a coroutine-debugging success claim.
limits.zh-CN: 未本地运行原故障或验证修复；缺 ELF、JIT map、实际完成 RPC 数及回调身份，尚不能确认根因，也不能列为协程调试成功案例。

scope.en: The text event headers match the binary perf records by thread ID, timestamp and period. Values below count recorded samples, not requests.
scope.zh-CN: 已按线程 ID、时间戳及 period 对齐文本事件头与 perf 二进制记录；下表计数是记录中的样本数，不是请求数。

rows: Contains unknown frame / 含 unknown 帧
C1/C2 compiler thread / 编译线程
Contains /debug/ DSO / 含 debug 目录共享库

notes.en: C++ inclusive path counts: request handler 1,165; subscriber handler 388; response Finish 612; CompletionQueue 212. These groups overlap. This does not isolate one dominant cause.
notes.zh-CN: C++ inclusive 路径计数：请求处理 1,165、subscriber handler 388、响应 Finish 612、CompletionQueue 212。这些分组重叠，尚未分离出单一主导原因。

notes.en: The C++ libraries occur under debug paths, which motivates checking build flags; the paths do not prove an unoptimized build. Java records substantial compilation activity and lacks many JIT symbols. Sample totals are not a validated per-RPC CPU ratio.
notes.zh-CN: C++ 库路径包含 debug，值得核对构建选项，但路径不能证明未优化。Java 有明显编译活动，并缺少许多 JIT 符号；样本总量之比不是已验证的逐 RPC CPU 比值。

notes.en: The CoroPerf perf-script reader was corrected to retain thread names containing spaces. Its regression passes; the resulting 3,515/801 event totals match an independent binary read. No creation edges were fabricated.
notes.zh-CN: 已修复 CoroPerf perf-script 读取器对含空格线程名的识别，回归检查通过；3,515／801 条事件数与独立二进制读取一致，未虚构创建边。
